item.title: Quantum Optimization for Feature Selection in Biomedical Data Online Workshop
item.description: Henry Liu of RPI will present research on feature selection for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) metabolomics data on Wednesday, 10/21/26 from 10:00 - 11:30 am. The work uses a QUBO formulation and quantum optimization to identify a small set of informative biomarkers from a rapidly growing space of possible feature combinations. For more information and link to join the workshop, please visit https://foci.rpi.edu/news-and-events

item.description: Friday, October 21, 6-9 pm Artist Nicole Chockrek has been collecting plastic from the environment since 2022. item.title: Atomic Habits: Division of Human Resources: Book Discussion Series
item.description: This session is designed to facilitate an open discussion of Atomic Habits by James Clear. Participants will reflect on the book’s key concepts, share perspectives, and discuss practical ways to apply its principles to personal and professional growth. No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving–every day.

item.title: RPI Faculty and Staff Quick Learn Webinar: Considering Brave Spaces vs. Safe Spaces in Discussions
item.description:
Date: Thursday, October 22, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:30 PM - In this workshop we will look at the strategies around building brave spaces versus safe spaces and what that means in situations when in a learning environment with a group of peers discussing challenging topics. Maureen Fodera (Office of Undergraduate Education) will be presenting this workshop. Please register using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.
